title: Is that Airbnb
worth buying?
lines: s1
Is that Airbnb actually worth buying? Let's run the numbers in EquityFoundry, in under a minute.
s2
Pick short-term rental. Enter the price, then your nightly rate and occupancy. Add the cleaning fee and the platform's cut.
s3
Add your loan, then taxes, insurance and utilities. Vacancy and repairs are already built in.
s4
Here's your answer. Monthly cash flow, cash-on-cash return, and revenue per night, after every cost.
s5
Now test a slow season. Drop occupancy to fifty two percent and watch it update. Know the deal before you buy. EquityFoundry. Link in bio.

title: Pull your cash
back out?
lines: s1
Can you pull your cash back out of a rental? That's the BRRRR method. Here's how to check one in a minute.
s2
Pick BRRRR. Enter the purchase price and your rehab budget. Then the after-repair value, what it's worth once it's fixed.
s3
Add the refinance terms, and the rent you expect once the work is done.
s4
Here's your answer. Cash flow after the refinance, cash left in the deal, and the equity you created. The less cash left in, the stronger the deal.
s5
Save it and compare it with your other deals. Forge better deals. EquityFoundry. Link in bio.

title: Will this flip
make money?
lines: s1
Will this flip actually make money? Check it in under a minute with EquityFoundry.
s2
Pick fix and flip. Enter the purchase price, your repair budget, and the after-repair value.
s3
Add how long you'll hold it, your selling costs, and the loan carrying it.
s4
Here's your answer. Profit, return on investment, and the seventy percent rule, so you know your maximum offer.
s5
Offer too high? Lower the price and watch the profit climb. Know the deal before you buy. EquityFoundry. Link in bio.
